fn help_command(prog: &str, args: &[OsString]) -> Result<Action, String> {
    let mut context = Context::Root;
    for arg in args {
        let value = arg.to_string_lossy();
        if context == Context::Root && value == "completion" { context = Context::Completion; }
        else if context == Context::Root && value == "help" { context = Context::Help; }
        else {
            let footer = if context == Context::Help { String::new() } else { format!("\n{FOOTER}") };
            let value = printable(&value);
            return Err(format!("error: unrecognized subcommand '{value}'\n\nUsage: {}\n{footer}", usage(prog, context)));
        }
    }
    Ok(Action::Text(help(prog, match context { Context::Root => "", Context::Completion => "completion", Context::Help => "help" })))
}

pub fn parse(prog: &str, args: &[OsString]) -> Result<Action, String> {
    let mut cfg = Config { horizontal: 1.0, vertical: 1.0, padding: 0, strict: false, file: None };
    let mut seen = [false; 4];
    let mut context = Context::Root;
    let mut shell: Option<String> = None;
    let mut end_options = false;
    let mut i = 0usize;
    while i < args.len() {
        let arg = args[i].to_string_lossy();
        let matched = cfg.file.is_some() || seen.iter().any(|&s| s);
        if !end_options && arg == "--" {
            end_options = true;
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if !end_options && arg.starts_with('-') && arg != "-" {
            let index = option_index(&arg, context)
                .ok_or_else(|| unexpected(&arg, prog, context, matched, true))?;
            let long = arg.starts_with("--");
            let attached = if long {
                arg.split_once('=').map(|(_,value)| value.to_string())
            } else {
                let rest = &arg[2..];
                if rest.is_empty() { None } else { Some(rest.strip_prefix('=').unwrap_or(rest).to_string()) }
            };
            if index >= 4 {
                if long {
                    if let Some(value) = attached {
                        let value = printable(&value);
                        let flag = OPT_DISPLAY[index];
                        let u = if context == Context::Root { format!("{prog} {flag} [FILE]") }
                            else { format!("{prog} completion {flag} <SHELL>") };
                        return Err(format!("error: unexpected value '{value}' for '{flag}' found; no more were expected\n\nUsage: {u}\n\n{FOOTER}"));
                    }
                }
                if index == 4 { return Ok(Action::Text("code-minimap 0.6.8\n".to_string())); }
                return Ok(Action::Text(help(prog, if context == Context::Root { "" } else { "completion" })));
            }
            let display = OPT_DISPLAY[index];
            let values = if index == 3 { Some(ENCODINGS) } else { None };
            let invalid_utf8;
            let value = if let Some(s) = attached {
                invalid_utf8 = args[i].to_str().is_none();
                s
            } else {
                if i + 1 == args.len() { return Err(value_missing(display, values)); }
                let next = args[i+1].to_string_lossy();
                if next.starts_with('-') && next != "-" {
                    if next == "--" || option_index(&next, context).is_some() {
                        return Err(value_missing(display, values));
                    }
                    return Err(unexpected(&next, prog, context, matched, true));
                }
                i += 1;
                invalid_utf8 = args[i].to_str().is_none();
                next.to_string()
            };
            if seen[index] {
                return Err(format!("error: the argument '{display}' cannot be used multiple times\n\nUsage: {}\n\n{FOOTER}", usage(prog, context)));
            }
            if invalid_utf8 && index < 3 {
                return Err(format!("error: invalid UTF-8 was detected in one or more arguments\n\nUsage: {}\n\n{FOOTER}", usage(prog, context)));
            }
            match index {
                0 => cfg.horizontal = value.parse::<f64>().map_err(|e| invalid_value(&value, display, &e.to_string()))?,
                1 => cfg.vertical = value.parse::<f64>().map_err(|e| invalid_value(&value, display, &e.to_string()))?,
                2 => cfg.padding = value.parse::<usize>().map_err(|e| invalid_value(&value, display, &e.to_string()))?,
                3 => cfg.strict = enum_value(&value, display, ENCODINGS, true)? == "utf8",
                _ => unreachable!(),
            }
            seen[index] = true;
        } else if !end_options && context == Context::Root && arg == "help" {
            return help_command(prog, &args[i+1..]);
        } else if !end_options && context == Context::Root && arg == "completion" {
            context = Context::Completion;
        } else if context == Context::Root {
            if cfg.file.is_some() { return Err(unexpected(&arg, prog, context, matched, false)); }
            if arg.is_empty() { return Err(value_missing("[FILE]", None)); }
            cfg.file = Some(PathBuf::from(&args[i]));
        } else {
            if shell.is_some() { return Err(unexpected(&arg, prog, context, matched, false)); }
            shell = Some(enum_value(&arg, "<SHELL>", SHELLS, false)?);
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    if context == Context::Completion {
        if let Some(shell) = shell { return Ok(Action::Completion(shell)); }
        return Err(format!("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <SHELL>\n\nUsage: {}\n\n{FOOTER}", usage(prog, context)));
    }
    Ok(Action::Render(cfg))
}


pub fn printable(text: &str) -> String {
    if crate::display::use_color(true) { return text.to_string(); }

"""Public-interface regression tests; no reference executable is required."""
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EXE = ROOT / "executable"
FOOTER = "For more information, try '--help'.\n"
USAGE = "Usage: executable [OPTIONS] [FILE] [COMMAND]\n"


class MinimapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def invoke(self, args=(), data=b"", env=None, cwd=None, stdout=subprocess.PIPE):
        environment = os.environ.copy()
        for name in ("CLICOLOR_FORCE", "CLICOLOR", "NO_COLOR", "COLUMNS"):
            environment.pop(name, None)
        environment["TERM"] = "dumb"
        if env:
            environment.update(env)
        return subprocess.run(
            [str(EXE), *args], input=data, stdout=stdout,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=environment, cwd=cwd,
        )

    def check_render(self, text, expected, args=()):
        if isinstance(text, str):
            text = text.encode()
        result = self.invoke(args, text)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"")
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, expected.encode())

    def check_error(self, args, expected):
        result = self.invoke(args)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, b"")
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr.decode(), expected)

    def test_empty_and_line_endings(self):
        for text, expected in [
            ("", ""), ("\n", "⠀\n"), (" " * 40, "⠀\n"),
            ("\n" * 4, "⠀\n"), ("\n" * 5, "⠀\n⠀\n"),
            ("a", "⠁\n"), ("a\n", "⠁\n"),
            ("a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\n", "⡇\n"),
            ("a\rb", "⠉⠁\n"),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(text=repr(text)):
                self.check_render(text, expected)

    def test_braille_cells(self):
        self.check_render("ab\ncd\nef\ngh\n", "⣿\n")
        self.check_render("a\na\na\na\na\n", "⡇\n⠁\n")
        self.check_render("x\n x\n  x\n   x\n", "⠑⢄\n")
        self.check_render("abcdef", "⠉⠉⠉\n")

    def test_spans_and_indentation(self):
        self.check_render("a       b", "⠉⠉⠉⠉⠁\n")
        self.check_render("   a   b    ", "⠀⠈⠉⠉\n")
        self.check_render("\t\t\t\ta\t", "⠀⠀⠁\n")
        self.check_render("a\vbc\fde", "⠉⠉⠉⠁\n")
        self.check_render("a\x00b", "⠉⠁\n")

    def test_byte_positions_for_unicode(self):
        for text, expected in [
            ("中", "⠁\n"), ("中a", "⠉⠉\n"),
            ("a😀b", "⠉⠉⠉\n"), ("éééé", "⠉⠉⠉⠁\n"),
            ("e\u0301", "⠉\n"), ("\u3000a", "⠀⠈\n"),
            ("\u00a0a", "⠀⠁\n"), ("\u200ba", "⠉⠉\n"),
            ("\u001ca", "⠉\n"),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                self.check_render(text, expected)

    def test_independent_row_widths(self):
        self.check_render(
            "abcde\na\n\n\nabcdefghi\n\n\n\na\n",
            "⠋⠉⠁\n⠉⠉⠉⠉⠁\n⠁\n",
        )
        self.check_render("\n\n\n\nabcdefgh\n", "⠀\n⠉⠉⠉⠉\n")

    def test_padding_is_a_minimum_width(self):
        for padding in (0, 1, 2, 10):
            self.check_render("a", "⠁" + " " * max(0, padding - 1) + "\n",
                              ["--padding", str(padding)])
        self.check_render("abcdef", "⠉⠉⠉\n", ["--padding", "1"])
        self.check_render("\n", "    \n", ["-H", "0.5", "--padding", "4"])
        self.check_render("", "", ["--padding", "100"])

    def test_horizontal_scaling(self):
        for scale, text, expected in [
            ("0", "abcdefgh", "\n"), ("0.25", "abcd", "⠁\n"),
            ("0.25", "    a", "⠀\n"), ("0.5", "a", "\n"),
            ("0.5", "ab", "⠁\n"), ("0.5", "  a", "⠀\n"),
            ("0.5", "   a", "⠈\n"), ("0.75", "abc", "⠉\n"),
            ("1.5", "ab", "⠉⠁\n"), ("2", " a", "⠀⠉\n"),
            ("3", "\n", "⠀⠀\n"), ("nan", "abcd", "\n"),
            ("-1", "abcd", "\n"),
            ("0.99999999", "a", "\n"),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(scale=scale, text=text):
                self.check_render(text, expected, ["--horizontal-scale=" + scale])

    def test_vertical_scaling(self):
        self.check_render("ab\n" * 8, "⣿\n", ["-V", "0.5"])
        self.check_render("ab\n" * 8, "⠛\n", ["-V", "0.25"])
        self.check_render("ab\n" * 8, "⣿\n⣿\n", ["-V", "2"])
        self.check_render("x\n       x\n", "⠉⠉⠉⠉\n", ["-V", "0.5"])
        self.check_render("\n      x\n", "⠀⠀⠀⠁\n", ["-V", "0"])
        self.check_render("x\n       x\n", "⠉⠉⠉⠉\n", ["-V", "nan"])
        self.check_render("x\n       x\n", "⠁⠀⠀⠐\n", ["-V", "inf"])
        self.check_render("a\n" * 14, "⡇\n", ["-V", "0.3"])
        self.check_render("a\n" * 15, "⡇\n⠁\n", ["-V", "0.3"])

    def test_lossy_decoding(self):
        self.check_render(b"a\xffb", "⠉⠉⠁\n")
        self.check_render(b"\xe2\x82", "⠁\n")
        self.check_render(b"\xed\xa0\x80", "⠉⠉⠉⠁\n")
        self.check_render(b"a\xc0\x80b", "⠉⠉⠉⠉\n")
        self.check_render(b"\xff", "⠁\n", ["--encoding", "UTF8-LOSSY"])

    def test_strict_decoding_retains_completed_rows_only(self):
        for lines, scale, expected in [(3, "1", ""), (4, "1", "⣿⣿\n"),
                                       (5, "1", "⣿⣿\n"), (7, "0.5", ""),
                                       (8, "0.5", "⣿⣿\n"), (8, "0", "")]:
            with self.subTest(lines=lines, scale=scale):
                result = self.invoke(["--encoding", "UtF8", "-V", scale],
                                     b"good\n" * lines + b"\xff\n")
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
                self.assertEqual(result.stdout.decode(), expected)
                self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"code-minimap: stream did not contain valid UTF-8\n")

    def test_file_input(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "input.txt"
            path.write_bytes(b"ab\ncd\nef\ngh\n")
            result = self.invoke([str(path)], b"ignored\n")
            self.assertEqual((result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr),
                             (0, "⣿\n".encode(), b""))
            (Path(directory) / "-").write_bytes(b"a\n")
            self.assertEqual(self.invoke(["-"], b"ignored", cwd=directory).stdout, "⠁\n".encode())
        result = self.invoke(["/definitely/not/a/minimap/input"])
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"code-minimap: No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
        result = self.invoke([str(ROOT)])
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"code-minimap: Is a directory (os error 21)\n")

    def test_help_and_version(self):
        for args in (["--help"], ["-h"], ["help"]):
            result = self.invoke(args)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
            self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"")
            self.assertTrue(result.stdout.startswith(b"A high performance code minimap generator\n\n"))
            self.assertIn(USAGE.encode(), result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(len(result.stdout), 711)
        result = self.invoke(["--version", "--not-an-option"])
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, b"code-minimap 0.6.8\n")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)

    def test_argument_diagnostics(self):
        self.check_error(["-H", "abc"],
            "error: invalid value 'abc' for '--horizontal-scale <HSCALE>': invalid float literal\n\n" + FOOTER)
        self.check_error(["--padding", "-1"],
            "error: unexpected argument '-1' found\n\n  tip: to pass '-1' as a value, use '-- -1'\n\n" + USAGE + "\n" + FOOTER)
        self.check_error(["--encoding", "utf-8"],
            "error: invalid value 'utf-8' for '--encoding <ENCODING>'\n  [possible values: utf8-lossy, utf8]\n\n"
            "  tip: a similar value exists: 'utf8'\n\n" + FOOTER)
        self.check_error(["--padding"],
            "error: a value is required for '--padding <PADDING>' but none was supplied\n\n" + FOOTER)
        self.check_error(["--padding", "2", "--padding", "3"],
            "error: the argument '--padding <PADDING>' cannot be used multiple times\n\n" + USAGE + "\n" + FOOTER)

    def test_validation_order(self):
        result = self.invoke(["-H", "bad", "--unknown"])
        self.assertTrue(result.stderr.startswith(b"error: unexpected argument '--unknown' found"))
        result = self.invoke(["-H=bad", "--unknown"])
        self.assertTrue(result.stderr.startswith(b"error: invalid value 'bad'"))
        result = self.invoke(["-H", "bad", "completion", "--help"])
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertTrue(result.stdout.startswith(b"Generate shell completion file\n"))
        result = self.invoke(["completion", "bad", "more"])
        self.assertTrue(result.stderr.startswith(b"error: unexpected argument 'more'"))

            "elvish": "a83757a70bb3083713f873f1dce0db1e47386ecbf7771f035f5b0b1ff23546ee",
            "fish": "ab401c5ca8f3e75bf47eadcffc8a2147d7a10aec1e6e01a4d50f9db66ca4dc34",

            "zsh": "ba5bd23265ab1434e49e76a0e2bc9fd63bbd5a9f5409d8ecb1bf4c7b94702d82",
        }
        for shell, digest in expected.items():
            with self.subTest(shell=shell):
                result = self.invoke(["completion", shell])
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
                self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"")

    def test_help_width_and_color(self):

        self.assertIn(b"\x1b[1m\x1b[33mUsage:\x1b[0m", result.stdout)

        self.assertNotIn(b"\x1b", result.stdout)

    def test_output_errors(self):

            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
            self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"code-minimap: No space left on device (os error 28)\n")
            result = self.invoke(["--help"], stdout=output)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
            self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"")

    unittest.main()
